step_open: Click Open ego lite and it opens on that Mac (with Screen Sharing on, use View screen at the top of this page to work it from here)
step_import: In its first-run setup, import data from Chrome (or another browser): your sign-ins to websites come along. macOS asks for the keychain password several times; enter that Mac's login password each time. You can skip importing
step_finish: Finish the first-run setup; it installs the ego-browser command
step_recheck: Come back here and click Check again
ready_imported: Another browser's data was imported; the assistant can use those sign-ins
ready_not_imported: No other browser's data was imported: sign in to the sites you need once in ego lite
ready_analytics_on: Turn off ego's usage statistics: in ego lite on that Mac, open Settings › Sync and services and turn off "Automatically sends usage statistics and crash reports to Citro Labs"
not_installed: ego lite isn't installed on this Mac yet
setup_opened: ego lite is open on that Mac; follow the steps below to finish its first-run setup
setup_needed: ego lite is installed; its first-run setup still needs finishing
ready: Ready · the assistant can use this Mac's browser
ready_version: Ready · the assistant can use this Mac's browser · ego lite {version}
